is: Zurfur's I/O-free core — the platform's nouns and the trait seams every adapter implements; deliberately transitional, to split into per-namespace crates (identity, gallery, workflow, plugin).
conventions: Every element mirrors a design glossary page (`entities/` in the corpus); the page pointer lives in this node's `refs`, never in a doc comment.
Stub modules are allowed, and documented honestly as stubs.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: value-object deps: chrono, uuid, cid, serde, zeroize, async-trait; tokio io-util only to name AsyncRead for the streaming FileStore port

fs.name: src/
fs.role: elements + ports + the clock + the string builder

fs.name: tests/
fs.role: fact_contract.rs — the Fact contract (commission-anchored evidence blocks hard deletion); elements_do_not_import_ports.rs — dependency-direction guard (elements never depend on ports)

notes: See also: the design corpus glossary — `entities/` in ZurNetwork/zurfur-design, indexed by `docs/design-index.md`.
See also: ZMVP-67 (tests/fact_contract.rs: the Fact contract's origin ticket).
